title: Ponte resolved product
description: What Ponte knows about a product once it has understood one, in the seven layers section D of the AI product intake decision requires preserved. The code-level contract is lib/products/model.ts (ResolvedProduct); this file is the machine-readable record of it. Carried on the submit payload as `product_resolution`; `listings` has no column for it yet and adding one is a migration this decision does not authorise.

originalWording.description: The member's own words, verbatim, in whatever language they used. Never replaced by the normalised name: North Star 3.4 puts the user's language above the database's.

productKey.description: The stable catalogue key, so a record can be re-read without string matching.

synonyms.description: Trade terminology and standard designations that reach this product.

categoryPath.description: Family, sector, group, product. The sector comes from PRODUCT_SECTORS in lib/taxonomy/market.ts and is never restated independently.

attributes.description: The distinguishing technical attributes of Ponte's product record. NOT claims the member's document made; those are carried separately and marked as extracted.

candidateHs.description: A SUGGESTED customs classification, or null. Downstream and confirmable. It must not block product intake, and it is never rendered as settled while `confirmed` is false.

searchTerms.description: The token set used for semantic retrieval.

provenance.description: Where this came from. Four states, never collapsed into one generic verified treatment (Design Constitution section 14). `ponte_verified` is declared for completeness and is never produced by the product intake journey: Ponte does not verify a product claim there, and the review screen renders the row as unavailable rather than as an empty box implying one could be obtained.
